Use attached image as STYLE/LAYOUT reference only: warm photographic editorial scene, cream/gold heading, bold navy typography, gold memory caption and pale blue Swedish example strip. This card's supplied new scene and exact text, including å ä ö. Clear readable type fully inside margins. One square image.
